rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a mistake or error, especially when taking blame for it.

example.english: This time, it was my mistake.
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 co3

rows.note: Use this more formal or written noun for an error in a test, document, system, or official context.

example.english: There is a mistake in this document.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 jau5 jat1 go3 co3 ng6
